notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
Added an optional circuit-bypass button to the elevator "lights on/off" puzzle.
This is for players that find the puzzle too difficult and want to bypass it.

notes.title: Updated to beta-1c
notes.content:
Beta-1C has been updated. Fixes and changes as follows:

- Updated physics for specific objects
- Kinematic objects intentionally pushed through walls will be reset to grabbed position
- Closed-captions now default to "on" per the tutorial audio. If you've already saved preferences on prior games, this has no effect.
